- Mr. Fuji rescue sequence scripting
- Item pickups, Pokemon cries, Silph Scope checks

Tower description sign, Clefairy mourner, cursed stone child.

dialogue, ghostgirl '...' lines. Synthesis: Fuji's deeper
connection to fusion research. Blue lines rewritten for tone.
Rocket lines given Synthesis menace. Master Ball plot preserved.

Darkness flavor text for item event.
- Map 403 (F4): Channeler pre/post-battle lines. Ghostgirl ...
